# justingreenbaum.com

> Personal site of Justin R. Greenbaum, a customer operations and experience executive who leads and transforms complex customer operations, and founder of Greenbaum Labs. More than 20 years in customer operations, frontline technical support to Vice President at Comcast: customer care, contact centers, technical support, global partner operations, digital service and customer intelligence, with applied AI as leverage.

## About Justin
- Customer operations and experience executive; Comcast 2005–2025, frontline technical support to Vice President
- Founder, Greenbaum Labs, an independent advisory and applied-AI practice
- MIT Sloan AI Executive Academy, NVIDIA Academy AI Infrastructure Professional Workshop, Prosci Change Management Practitioner Program
- Creator of the Coherence diagnostic framework

- [Operating Method](https://justingreenbaum.com/operating-method): How he diagnoses operating failure — truth, authority, continuity

## Core Concepts
- **Truth:** Whether narrative aligns with evidence
- **Authority:** Whether decision rights match accountability
- **Continuity:** Whether decisions, rationale, and learning persist over time
- Technical and diagnostic work lives at greenbaumlabs.com
